data.Title: Cisza nocna
data.Writer: Bartosz M. Kowalski, Pawel Maslona, Mirella Zaradkiewicz
data.Actors: Maciej Damiecki, Zdzislaw Wardejn, Wlodzimierz Press
data.Plot: Lucjan is admitted to a nursing home, where he is welcomed by the residents and staff. Everything is fine, there are no dark secrets hidden in the basement, no strange, malevolent creatures. Don't worry about it. Everything - is -...
